summary: GitHub Release update client, system installer handoff, release workflow, automated gates and the 0.1.1 debug APK are delivered. Stage remains BLOCKED only on real GitHub Release download and same-signature device upgrade acceptance.

limitations: The delivered debug APK intentionally has no GITHUB_REPOSITORY because this local Git repository has no remote; its parent UI displays the unconfigured state and makes no placeholder request.
The GitHub Actions workflow has not run because there is no configured remote repository and no repository signing secrets in this workspace.
Real Release download, unknown-source system flow and same-signature overlay upgrade require a public GitHub Release plus a working physical Android device or emulator; those checks are NOT_RUN.
